تزدلفين (form VIII)
# تَزْدَلِفِينَ (tazdalifīna) /taz.da.li.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# تُزْدَلَفِينَ (tuzdalafīna) /tuz.da.la.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
